doc: M2-FP-102/113: the three Haluna villager bodies creatures' VillagerLayer (M3-CRE-613, game/data/world/npc/zones/ch02_haluna.json, the owner of Haluna's villagers) doesn't cover yet: the shopkeeper, smith and innkeeper have no model of their own, so each wears another villager's (stand_in_for) until M2-CHR-100. HalunaVillagers (game/levels/ch02/haluna/haluna_villagers.gd) gives each body a FieldNpc with that actor. body: the StaticBody3D's path in haluna.tscn; talk: its Interactable (a sibling); hide: the stand-in meshes the actor replaces. Move these rows into VillagerLayer's data (request M3-CRE-100) and delete this file once the models exist.
